status: frozen before receipt of more-wind-take microphone audio
method: Projected rim ellipse correction; four-arm trajectories establish full-turn count; local quadratic interpolation of fitted sharp arm edges at reversals; averages across repeated cycles. Upper arm and full-motion fits are cross-checks.
limitations: Uncalibrated loupe distortion and partly occluded features.
Lower arm edges are primary. Upper-arm fits are less consistent near fixed hardware, particularly at 15–17 s; this interval retains a wider allowance.
Pen marks are not clearly exposed at both reversals; primary endpoint measurements use arm edges.
Shared systematic uncertainty is not reduced by number of cycles.

sections.allowance_type: practical systematic allowance, not a statistical confidence interval
sections.definition: half total unwrapped angular travel between opposite reversals
sections.primary_feature: both edges of lower balance arm, radii 88–103 pixels in ellipse-normalized crop
